description: Lifts and elevator floor terminals the runtime policy enables and powers, because the vanilla phase that would power them never runs in the clean slate. disable_authorization also turns off an authorization module whose keycard the player cannot get. id is the engine entity id the sweep logs. tools/venue-proposals.py door-scope generates the lists into src/r6/scripts/NeonAscendancy/World/DoorScope.reds; DeviceOverrides.reds applies them.
